Emily: Quick heads-up 1: I sketched a one-page migration cheat-sheet for v1->v2 to feed into the deprecation email. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/622

Tom: Love that. Can it be razor-short? We need a small checklist and 3 copy-paste snippets: curl v1, v2 SDK, and a quick field-mapping example.

Emily: Yup. Draft snips: 
```
# v1 curl (old)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/text-gen/outputs -d '{"input":"hello"}'

# v2 python (new)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=...)
r = c.responses.create(model="redwood-alpha", input="hello")
print(r.output[0].content)
```

Noor: Add a tiny mapping note: v1 `choices[0].text` -> v2 `output[0].content`. Also mention tokenization/quantization differences. One sentence each.

Ben: We should include 2 operational gotchas: 1) KV cache cold-start after model swap (warm with short requests), 2) pinned model versions in Dedicated need explicit rollout.

Emily: Good. I'll add one-line mitigations for both. Also adding a mini-snippet for streaming with completion event: 
```
# streaming v2
with c.responses.stream(model="redwood-stream", input="summarize this") as s:
  for ev in s:
    if ev.type == "delta":
      print(ev.delta, end="")
    if ev.type == "response.completed":
      print("\nmetadata:", ev.metadata)
```

docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken anchor in docs/guides/migration-cheatsheet.md -> `#old-response-format`.

Tom: I'll send a tiny fix to the anchor. Also proposed timeline blurb: "v1 endpoints deprecated 2026-07-01; redirects maintained until 2026-06-15." Keep it short for the email.

Noor: Can we add a single-line CLI command to run a local eval that compares baseline? Small example: `ri-eval compare --base=baseline --head=post-migration`.

Emily: Added that. I also slugged an automated migrator script reference: tools/migrate-v1-to-v2.sh (customers can try in a sandbox).

Ben: Flag: make sure SDK changelog has a clear breaking-change entry linking to the cheat-sheet. I'll add the changelog note in the SDK release PR.

Emily: Great, landing after link fix + tiny wording edits. Tagging @Tom and @Noor for quick review.
